text.jp: ダグザ暦１４５０年初頭――
text.official_en: Dagdan Imperial Calendar, year 1450.

text.jp:
大剣闘祭の閉幕に呼応したかの如く覚醒した
神威大帝ダグザは神威法王ソレルの
叛意を厳しく断罪するとともに、
サラミス王国に対する宣戦布告を行った。
text.official_en:
After the Heroic Games, the Divine Emperor Dagda
awoke, retook his throne, and began a new year with
bold proclamations. He named Lord Solel a traitor,
his reign invalid, and declared war on Saramis.
text.real_en:
After the Great Gladiatorial Festival, the Divine Emperor Dagda
awoke, retook his throne, and began a new year with
bold proclamations. He named Lord Sorell a traitor,
his reign invalid, and declared war on Saramis.

text.jp:
この驚くべき報は人々へと瞬く間に広がると、
ダグザの地全土に激震をもたらした。
これを受けたサラミス王国の女王セオドラは
ダグザ帝国への徹底反抗を即時決断するのだった。
text.official_en:
The emperor's statements shook the entire continent.
People everywhere feared what would come next.
Queen Theodora rose up in defense of the Saramis
nation, stoking open rebellion against the empire.

text.jp:
セオドラは戦への準備を調えつつ各地に使者を
派遣し、協力する意思のあるものを集め、
戦力の拡充を図る。
text.official_en:
Theodora sought allies for her sudden war. She sent
emissaries far and wide, hoping that others would
join her cause and bolster her forces.

text.jp:
その結果、多くの者達がこれに賛同し、
名のある強者たちがセオドラのもとに
続々と集まってくるのだった。
text.official_en:
Many of them joined her rebellion. One powerful
warrior after another took their place at Theodora's
side, ready to defend her people.

text.jp:
激しい戦いの中、どれほどの苦境にあっても自ら
先陣を切って戦い、活路を切り開いてゆく
セオドラの姿は周囲を鼓舞し、軍団は
連戦の中、高い士気を保ち続けるのだった。
text.official_en:
Theodora led the march against the empire, standing
at the fore in battle after battle. No matter the risk,
no matter how fierce the fight, she cleaved a path
to victory. The queen was a true inspiration.

text.jp:
そして、ダグザ暦１４５０年４月――
アルシネウス大橋の戦いを下した連合軍は、
いよいよ神威大帝の待つダグシオンに
手の届く場所に到達していた。
text.official_en:
Then in Efraul of that year, the Alliance was finally
able to march on Dagsion itself. After winning the
Battle of Alcineus Span, they pushed onward, to
challenge the Divine Emperor inside his city.
text.real_en:
Then in Efraul of that year, the Alliance was finally
able to march on Dagsion itself. After winning the
Battle of the Great Alcineus Bridge, they pushed onward, to
challenge the Divine Emperor inside his city.

text.jp:
だが、すべての背後に蠢く陰謀と、戦いの先で
ダグザの地を襲う壮絶なる運命について、
この時はまだ誰も知る由もなかったのである。
text.official_en:
But as they entered Dagsion, not one of them knew
what had lurked behind the throne all along—or of
the nightmare about to dawn over the land of Dagda.

text.jp:
――聖キッホル著「ダグザ戦乱史」　
巻頭序文より
text.official_en:
—Saint Cichol, "History of the Dagdan War,"
Foreword

text.official_en:
She sent an emissary to ask Cai to join her cause.
He and his family had recently settled into their
new life in a house on the edge of Dagsion.

He and his family had recently settled into their
new life in a house on the edge of Dagsion.

text.jp:
セオドラと自分との間に縁を感じていたカイは
協力することを決意。家族の後押しも受けて、
この戦争に身を投じることとなる。
text.official_en:
He was resolved to help Theodora, feeling a strong
and lasting bond with the queen. So, with his
family's blessing, Cai went off to fight in the war.

みるみるその頭角を現してゆく。精鋭にして強者
揃いのサラミス軍団の中にあって、カイは
周囲から一目置かれる存在になってゆくのだった。
text.official_en:
Cai quickly proved himself to be an invaluable
member of the Alliance. Even the elite Saramis
warriors remarked on his superior combat skills.
And his battle successes were spectacular.

サラミス軍への協力を要請する使者が訪れる。
text.official_en:
Theodora sent an emissary to ask Dietrich to join her
cause. After his fierce battles in the Heroic Games,
he'd stayed awhile longer in the city of Dagsion.

text.jp:
話を聞くうちにダグザ大帝を斬りたいという
強い衝動にかられたディートリヒはこれを承諾、
サラミス軍団に合流するのだった。
text.official_en:
Dietrich received this call to action in his unique
way, overcome with the urge to cut down Dagda the
Great. He joined the Saramis war immediately.

text.jp:
戦いの中、ディートリヒは思う存分に己の
殺戮衝動を満たしていた。その鬼神の如き姿を見た
サラミスの兵士たちは、彼が味方でよかったと
心から安堵するのだった。
text.official_en:
He relished each and every opportunity during the
campaign to slaughter the enemy. The Saramis 
soldiers were relieved—deeply—that someone with
such a demonic disposition was their ally in battle.

南方への旅の支度を進めていたレダの元に、
合流を呼びかけるサラミスの使者が訪れる。
text.official_en:
She sent an emissary to ask Leda to join her cause.
Leda was preparing for a journey south—to find a
way to save her father's soul.

text.jp:
神威大帝のやり方に強い反発を抱いたレダは
サラミスの側に加担することを決断、
この戦争に身を投じる道を選ぶのだった。
text.official_en:
The Divine Emperor's edicts were already striking
her as tyranny in motion. So, strongly opposed,
Leda went off to fight in the Saramis rebellion.

text.jp:
戦いの中、鮮烈な演奏で友軍を鼓舞するレダ。
黒曜の力は同時に彼女自身の魂を削ぐような
苦痛を伴ったが、それによって力づけられ、
戦い抜くことが出来た者も多かったという。
text.official_en:
Her performances were the secret to the army's
strong morale during the war campaign. Obsidian
seemed to eat at her very soul. But Leda played on,
battle after battle, inspiring the troops to keep going.
